explanation: Choux dough is cooked in a pan before baking. In the oven its water turns to steam and inflates each piece, leaving a hollow shell to fill with cream.

claims.text: Éclairs and profiteroles are made from choux pastry.
Éclairs and profiteroles are not made from puff, filo or shortcrust pastry.
Choux dough (water, butter and flour) is cooked in a pan before eggs are beaten in and it is baked.
Choux pastry rises in the oven because the water in the dough turns to steam, leaving a hollow inside.
